mapper.insert: INSERT INTO USER_INFO (USER_ID, USER_NAME, PASSWORD, PASSWORD_SALT, EMAIL, PHONE, ROLES, BIRTH_DATE) VALUES (#{id}, #{name}, #{password}, #{passwordSalt}, #{email}, #{phone}, #{roles}, #{birthDate})
mapper.select: SELECT USER_ID AS ID, USER_NAME AS NAME, PASSWORD, PASSWORD_SALT, ROLES FROM USER_INFO WHERE USER_ID = #{id} AND IS_DELETED = 'N'
